physical.title: Synthetic native finite aperture: central opening and downstream detector

interpretation.requestedResult: Native absorption by the two opaque aperture arms, and actual downstream detector crossings
assumptions: Entirely synthetic apparatus, not inferred from a JEE problem.
Finite straight line with a 30 mm transparent centred opening, two opaque arms and native PhyDemo Aperture absorption.
